notes: The pinned IEEE 1516.1-2025 clause-7 requirement candidate states that adding or subtracting a logical-time interval to or from final logical time yields final logical time. This contract exercises the standard C++ value classes against the installed provider library; it does not inspect private provider state or assert behavior for other arithmetic boundaries.
